title: Breathing and moving vesicles in a geometric mechanochemical model
summary: We consider a geometric mechanochemical model of vesicles which couples the Helfrich flow for the shape of a lipid bilayer vesicle membrane $X$ with a reaction-diffusion equations for a single ``morphogen'' $φ$ on $X$. The Helfrich flow is the $L^2$ gradient flow of the elastic bending energy $E(X)=\int_X (H-c_0)^2 dS$ of $X$, typically supplemented by area or volume constraints, or both. The morphogen $φ$ adsorbs/desorbs at places of high/low mean curvature $H$, i.e., the kinetics of $φ$ depend on $H$, and conversely $φ$ modifies the spontaneous curvature $c_0$ on $X$.
